placements.title: system design specifications governing pipeline behavior
placements.frame: What architectural decisions shape how the pipeline processes and commits memory submissions?

placements.title: the pipeline derives identity from content when none is supplied
placements.frame: How must the pipeline produce an identifier from memory content when no explicit id is provided?
placements.why: src-1 establishes the precondition — a submission arriving without an explicit id — and src-2 mandates the pipeline's response: generate a slug from memory content via the LLM id-gen call or the deterministic slugify fallback, then commit. Together they name a thematic subject future envelopes will feed: the pipeline's responsibility to derive identity from content when none is explicitly given.
